fieldValues.title: Place composite-renderer dispatch in the view layer
fieldValues.decision_rationale: Composite renderer choice is a presentation arrangement, not a property of a Field or Type. View ownership permits multiple legitimate presentations of the same records while retaining a portable precedence contract.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Composite renderer selection is owned by the view layer rather than Field or Type, so different views may present the same semantic records differently.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
- Keep compositeRenderer on FieldGroup or the replacement Type.
- Put renderer selection on each instance.
- Allow only a repository-wide renderer choice.
fieldValues.accepted_costs: Renderer declarations move to view capabilities and cannot be recovered from semantic Fields alone.
fieldValues.review_trigger: Review when renderer selection is proposed on a semantic definition or instance, or when view-level declarations cannot express a needed presentation.
